teaching.student_prompt: 指一指自己的牙，说 one tooth，再说 teeth。
teaching.note: 原创 KET 课堂例句；先读单词与例句，再学习构词或常用搭配。

word_study.explanation_zh: tooth 是一颗牙，复数是 teeth，不能直接加 -s。tooth 还能和 brush、paste 等词组合。

family.connection_zh: tooth 的不规则复数：oo 变为 ee。

example.en: I brush my teeth every morning.

challenge.prompt_zh: 一颗牙是 tooth，多颗牙怎么写？牙刷怎么写？

images.alt: 穿蓝色上衣的孩子微笑着，用手指指向一颗洁白的门牙。
images.caption: This tooth is very small.

generation_history.prompt: undefinedPrimary request: A cheerful fictional child about eight, fully dressed in an ordinary blue top, smiling naturally while pointing with one clean index finger to one healthy upper front tooth. Medium close portrait in a bright clean bathroom, tiny gap from a recently lost baby tooth is okay but no blood, injury or dental procedure. The finger is below the lip without obscuring the tooth. Focus on the single white tooth and understandable gesture, realistic relaxed face and hand.
